headline: Last session: Nifty ends at 22,600 as surging oil prices and West Asia tensions trigger fourth straight decline.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging global oil prices nearing $114 per barrel due to escalating West Asia tensions
Volatile crude prices impacting profit margins for major oil marketing companies
Profit booking by investors after the market snapped a two-week winning streak
Concerns over global economic stability following workforce reductions in major international firms
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 closed the last session at 22,600, marking its fourth consecutive daily loss
Coforge reported a 56.5% rise in net profit, supported by record deal wins and growth
Tata Motors posted a Q2 net profit of ₹1,257 crore and confirmed its Iveco acquisition is on track
IndusInd Bank saw growth in interest income and improved asset quality with a ₹1,242 crore profit
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices fell for a fourth session as Nifty settled at 22,600 amid rising crude prices and geopolitical tensions. While corporate earnings from Coforge and Tata Motors were strong, Bharat Petroleum faced pressure from volatile oil costs. The market is currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, October 26.
